question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.
solution:
The correct answer is **"numbed". **

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• It is the most appropriate option to fill in the blank as it fits the context of the sentence.
 
• Grammatically, it is the past tense and past participle form of the verb &
